# When Do Annex III High-Risk AI Obligations Apply Under the EU AI Act?

## Executive Summary
As originally adopted in 2024, obligations for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III of the EU AI Act were due to apply from 2 August 2026 (high confidence) ([European Parliament](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/topics/en/article/20230601STO93804/eu-ai-act-first-regulation-on-artificial-intelligence), [EU AI Act Implementation Timeline](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/implementation-timeline)). This date was subsequently extended by the "AI Omnibus" amendment to Article 113, and the current legally applicable date, confirmed by official EU sources, is **2 December 2027** (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force)). Unverified news reports of a further delay to 2029 are not corroborated by any official EU source and should be treated with significant caution.

## Key Findings

### Original Timeline
Under the AI Act as adopted in 2024, Annex III high-risk obligations were scheduled to take effect on 2 August 2026, 36 months after the Regulation's entry into force (high confidence) ([European Parliament](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/topics/en/article/20230601STO93804/eu-ai-act-first-regulation-on-artificial-intelligence), [Goodwin Law](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/10/insights-technology-aiml-eu-ai-act-implementation-timeline)).

### The AI Omnibus Amendment
The "AI Omnibus" (Digital Omnibus on AI) amended Article 113 to extend the Annex III application date to 2 December 2027 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force)). This legislative process moved through several stages: the proposal was adopted on 19 November 2025, political agreement was reached on 7 May 2026, and the Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026 (high confidence) ([European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai), [Council of the EU](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/05/07/artificial-intelligence-council-and-parliament-agree-to-simplify-and-streamline-rules)). The consolidated EUR-Lex text (version dated 27 July 2026) confirms that operator obligations are now tied to "the date of application of Chapter III referred to in Article 113," i.e., the amended date rather than the original 2026 date (high confidence) ([EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML?uri=CELEX%3A02024R1689-20260727)). According to the Council/Parliament press release, the agreement allows the Commission to adjust the timeline by up to 16 months, with application contingent on confirmation that necessary standards and compliance tools are available (medium confidence) ([Council of the EU](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/05/07/artificial-intelligence-council-and-parliament-agree-to-simplify-and-streamline-rules)).

### Related Deadlines
Obligations for high-risk AI systems classified as high-risk because they are safety components of products under existing EU product-safety legislation (Annex I) have been separately extended to 2 August 2028 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [Squire Patton Boggs](https://www.squirepattonboggs.com/media/h3pcmbj2/ai-timeline-implementation-and-compliance.pdf)). The Commission's AI Act Service Desk FAQ explicitly states Annex III obligations "will enter into force on 2 December 2027" and Annex I obligations "will enter into force on 2 August 2028" (medium confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation)). Separately, transparency obligations under Article 50 remain unaffected by these changes and apply from 2 August 2026 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/faq)). Member States should also have at least one AI regulatory sandbox operational by 2 August 2027 as part of the broader implementation path (medium confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/timeline/timeline-implementation-eu-ai-act)).

### Disputed Further Extension
A small number of September 2026 news/blog sources claim a second amendment further delayed the Annex III date to 2 August 2029, citing unreadiness of harmonised standards and notified bodies (low confidence) (e.g., [EU AI Act Legal Guide](https://eu-ai-act-legal-guide.example/2026/09/15/annex-iii-deadline-update)). This claim is not corroborated by any official EU source in this research.

## Contradictions & Uncertainties
- Some undated blog sources still cite 2 August 2026 as operative, reflecting outdated information superseded by the Omnibus amendment ([Cloud Security Alliance](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-eu-ai-act-high-risk-compliance-deadline-20) vs. [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai)).
- The claimed 2029 extension (low confidence, below 0.4) appears only in three uncorroborated blog/news sources with no legislative citation and is not confirmed by EUR-Lex, the Commission, or the Council ([EU AI Act Legal Guide](https://eu-ai-act-legal-guide.example/2026/09/15/annex-iii-deadline-update) vs. [AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation)).
- One source states the Annex I deadline as 2 August 2027 rather than 2028, inconsistent with the majority of sources ([Snowflake](https://www.snowflake.com/en/artificial-intelligence/ai-governance/eu-ai-act) vs. [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)).

## Knowledge Gaps
It remains unconfirmed whether the alleged 2029 extension is a genuine legislative change, a misreading of the Omnibus, or inaccurate reporting. The precise regulation number enacting the Article 113 amendment is inconsistently cited across sources. It is unclear whether 2 December 2027 is final or subject to further revision given the pattern of prior delays, and how conformity assessment and standards-readiness milestones might further affect this date.

# When Do Annex III High-Risk AI Obligations Apply Under the EU AI Act?

## Executive Summary
As originally adopted in 2024, obligations for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III of the EU AI Act were due to apply from 2 August 2026 (high confidence) ([European Parliament](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/topics/en/article/20230601STO93804/eu-ai-act-first-regulation-on-artificial-intelligence), [EU AI Act Implementation Timeline](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/implementation-timeline)). This date was subsequently extended by the "AI Omnibus" amendment to Article 113, and the current legally applicable date, confirmed by official EU sources, is **2 December 2027** (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force)). Unverified news reports of a further delay to 2029 are not corroborated by any official EU source and should be treated with significant caution.

## Key Findings

### Original Timeline
Under the AI Act as adopted in 2024, Annex III high-risk obligations were scheduled to take effect on 2 August 2026, 36 months after the Regulation's entry into force (high confidence) ([European Parliament](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/topics/en/article/20230601STO93804/eu-ai-act-first-regulation-on-artificial-intelligence), [Goodwin Law](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/10/insights-technology-aiml-eu-ai-act-implementation-timeline)).

### The AI Omnibus Amendment
The "AI Omnibus" (Digital Omnibus on AI) amended Article 113 to extend the Annex III application date to 2 December 2027 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force)). This legislative process moved through several stages: the proposal was adopted on 19 November 2025, political agreement was reached on 7 May 2026, and the Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026 (high confidence) ([European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai), [Council of the EU](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/05/07/artificial-intelligence-council-and-parliament-agree-to-simplify-and-streamline-rules)). The consolidated EUR-Lex text (version dated 27 July 2026) confirms that operator obligations are now tied to "the date of application of Chapter III referred to in Article 113," i.e., the amended date rather than the original 2026 date (high confidence) ([EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML?uri=CELEX%3A02024R1689-20260727)). According to the Council/Parliament press release, the agreement allows the Commission to adjust the timeline by up to 16 months, with application contingent on confirmation that necessary standards and compliance tools are available (medium confidence) ([Council of the EU](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/05/07/artificial-intelligence-council-and-parliament-agree-to-simplify-and-streamline-rules)).

### Related Deadlines
Obligations for high-risk AI systems classified as high-risk because they are safety components of products under existing EU product-safety legislation (Annex I) have been separately extended to 2 August 2028 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [Squire Patton Boggs](https://www.squirepattonboggs.com/media/h3pcmbj2/ai-timeline-implementation-and-compliance.pdf)). The Commission's AI Act Service Desk FAQ explicitly states Annex III obligations "will enter into force on 2 December 2027" and Annex I obligations "will enter into force on 2 August 2028" (medium confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation)). Separately, transparency obligations under Article 50 remain unaffected by these changes and apply from 2 August 2026 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/faq)). Member States should also have at least one AI regulatory sandbox operational by 2 August 2027 as part of the broader implementation path (medium confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/timeline/timeline-implementation-eu-ai-act)).

### Disputed Further Extension
A small number of September 2026 news/blog sources claim a second amendment further delayed the Annex III date to 2 August 2029, citing unreadiness of harmonised standards and notified bodies (low confidence) (e.g., [EU AI Act Legal Guide](https://eu-ai-act-legal-guide.example/2026/09/15/annex-iii-deadline-update)). This claim is not corroborated by any official EU source in this research.

## Contradictions & Uncertainties
- Some undated blog sources still cite 2 August 2026 as operative, reflecting outdated information superseded by the Omnibus amendment ([Cloud Security Alliance](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-eu-ai-act-high-risk-compliance-deadline-20) vs. [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai)).
- The claimed 2029 extension (low confidence, below 0.4) appears only in three uncorroborated blog/news sources with no legislative citation and is not confirmed by EUR-Lex, the Commission, or the Council ([EU AI Act Legal Guide](https://eu-ai-act-legal-guide.example/2026/09/15/annex-iii-deadline-update) vs. [AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation)).
- One source states the Annex I deadline as 2 August 2027 rather than 2028, inconsistent with the majority of sources ([Snowflake](https://www.snowflake.com/en/artificial-intelligence/ai-governance/eu-ai-act) vs. [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)).

## Knowledge Gaps
It remains unconfirmed whether the alleged 2029 extension is a genuine legislative change, a misreading of the Omnibus, or inaccurate reporting. The precise regulation number enacting the Article 113 amendment is inconsistently cited across sources. It is unclear whether 2 December 2027 is final or subject to further revision given the pattern of prior delays, and how conformity assessment and standards-readiness milestones might further affect this date.
